notes.title: King of Cooking v1.1.1 update
notes.content:
We applied the bug modifications and suggestions received.


 Fixed a bug that you cannot fry at first at the chicken nuggets store.
 Fixed abug that you get wrong even if you give properly at the chitterlings store.

notes.title: King of Coooking V1.1 Major Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing our game!
We fixed some known bugs and updated to improve convenience.

Convenience Update

Modified play guide to make it easier to understand
Play guides are modified to help you understand easier than before. 
You can check it in the start screen (How To button) and in-game (Tab key).
Feel free to check it during the game since the time does not pass while you are reading the guide.

Modified explanations at the item select screen
We added explanations for the effect and difficulty of each item.
Check the explanation to select the best item for you!

Added Super Easy Mode
A new mode for beginners is added.
Now you can take less care about stores you aren't playing.
You can play it by selecting the "Debit Card" item on the item selection screen.
Frozen time: Customers wait forever if you are not watching.

Nicer Customers at the fresh fruit juice store
Customers now tell you which fruits should be used for each menu.

Changed graphics at the chicken nuggets store
Now you can easily identify whether you have added rice cakes or not.
Also, you can easily notice burnt oil and stove.


Bug Fixes

Improved Translation
Fixed some untranslated parts.

Customers’ taste is back. 
At the chicken nugget store, fixed a bug where orders with certain sauce fail.

Customers’ counting ability is back too. 
At the chicken nugget store, fixed a bug where orders always fail when there’s no chicken on the stove.


Please feel free to report any additional bugs or suggestions.
Keep playing and have fun!
Thank you.

- Team EnE
